profile: kernelized squared margin: a squared-margin/soft-margin SVM cost in kernel methods. It evaluates a sum over data points of squared hinge terms, max(0, 1 - y_p(b + h^T z_p))^2. This is the squared margin form of soft-margin support vector machines.

It evaluates a sum over data points of squared hinge terms, max(0, 1 - y_p(b + h^T z_p))^2, penalizing violations of the margin by their square. This formulation appears as the squared margin variant within kernelized soft-margin support vector machines.
